topics.title: Brake Pad Replacement Cost 2026: Fair Price Guide
topics.description: Brake pad replacement in the US usually costs $150 to $450 per axle. See what parts and labor cost and how to avoid paying too much.
topics.answer: Brake pad replacement in the United States usually costs $150 to $450 per axle, with parts and labor included. Independent shops are often near $150 to $300, while dealers can reach $250 to $450. Adding new rotors raises the bill to roughly $300 to $800 per axle.
factors: Whether you also replace the rotors, which adds about $40 to $200 each.
Car type: trucks, luxury and performance cars cost more.
Pad quality: basic, ceramic or OEM pads have different prices.
Shop type: dealers charge more than independent shops.
Local labor rates, which are often $90 to $200 per hour.
Extra work such as caliper service or a brake fluid flush.
tips: Ask whether the rotors really need replacing or can be left as they are.
Compare an independent shop with the dealer.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Ask about aftermarket pads from a known brand versus OEM pads.
Replace pads before they wear down to metal, because that damages the rotors and costs more.
faq: How much does it cost to replace brake pads on one axle?
Most US shops charge about $150 to $450 per axle for pads only, parts and labor included. Independent shops are often at the lower end and dealers at the higher end.
How much to replace brake pads and rotors?
Pads and rotors together usually cost about $300 to $800 per axle. Trucks, luxury and performance cars can cost more.
Do I need to replace front and rear brake pads at the same time?
No. Front pads usually wear faster, so many cars need them replaced more often than the rear ones. Each axle is priced separately.
How long does a brake pad replacement take?
A pad job typically takes about 1 to 1.5 hours per axle at a shop.

topics.title: Car Battery Replacement Cost 2026: What You Should Pay
topics.description: A new car battery in the US costs about $120 to $450 installed. See what a fair price looks like and how to save on a replacement.
topics.answer: Replacing a standard 12-volt car battery in the United States usually costs about $120 to $450 installed. A basic battery sits at the low end, while an AGM battery for a newer car sits at the high end. Hybrid and EV traction batteries are a different job and cost thousands.
factors: Battery type: standard flooded or AGM, which costs more.
Vehicle: some cars need the new battery registered with the computer.
Where it is installed: retailers, independent shops and dealers differ.
Battery size and cold-cranking rating.
Hard-to-reach battery locations that need more labor.
Core charge and warranty length.
tips: Have the battery tested first, since a loose terminal or the alternator can look like a dead battery.
Compare retail store installation with a shop quote.
Ask how long the warranty is and whether it is prorated.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Do not pay for an AGM battery if your car does not require one.
faq: How much does a car battery cost installed?
Most drivers pay about $120 to $450 for a new battery installed in the US. Price depends on battery type and where you buy it.
How often should a car battery be replaced?
Many batteries last around 3 to 5 years, depending on climate and use. A weak battery often shows up as slow starting.
Is an AGM battery worth the extra money?
If your car came with an AGM battery, or has start-stop, replace it with an AGM one. Otherwise a standard battery is usually enough.
How much does a hybrid battery cost?
Hybrid drive batteries often cost about $2,000 to $6,000, though many are covered by a long warranty. The 12-volt battery in a hybrid is much cheaper.

topics.title: Clutch Replacement Cost 2026: Fair Price Guide for the US
topics.description: Clutch replacement in the US usually costs $750 to $2,500. See the parts and labor split and what makes your quote higher or lower.
topics.answer: Clutch replacement in the United States usually costs about $750 to $2,500 for parts and labor, and many everyday cars land between $1,200 and $1,800. All-wheel-drive, luxury and performance cars can cost $1,500 to $3,000. Labor is often half or more of the bill because the transmission must come out.
factors: Car type: AWD, luxury and performance cars cost more.
Dual-mass flywheels are costly and often cannot be resurfaced.
Labor: the transmission has to be removed, which takes many hours.
Whether the flywheel and release bearing are replaced at the same time.
Shop type and local labor rates, often $75 to $125 per hour or more.
Parts brand: OEM kits cost more than aftermarket kits.
tips: Ask the shop to confirm the clutch is really worn, not a hydraulic or cable fault that costs far less.
Ask to replace the flywheel work together with the clutch, which avoids paying labor twice.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask for the exact kit brand and whether it is OEM.
faq: How much does a clutch replacement cost?
In the US most clutch replacements cost about $750 to $2,500, parts and labor included. Many mainstream cars are between $1,200 and $1,800.
Why is clutch replacement so expensive?
The mechanic has to remove the transmission to reach the clutch, so labor is half or more of the total. The clutch kit itself is a smaller part of the bill.
How long does a clutch last?
A clutch often lasts many years, but driving style and traffic make a big difference. Slipping, a high pedal bite or a burning smell are common signs it is wearing out.
Can I replace only the clutch disc?
Shops usually recommend a full kit, with pressure plate and release bearing, because the labor is the same and it avoids a repeat job.

topics.title: Shock Absorber Replacement Cost 2026: What to Pay
topics.description: Shock and strut replacement in the US usually costs $500 to $2,500. See parts and labor prices and how to avoid overpaying.
topics.answer: Replacing shocks or struts in the United States typically costs about $500 to $2,500, depending on the car and whether you do one axle or all four. Parts run roughly $80 to $250 for a pair of shocks and $300 to $760 for a pair of struts, with labor of $100 to $300 per assembly. An alignment is often recommended afterward.
factors: Shocks or struts: struts cost more and take more labor.
One axle or all four wheels.
Car type: trucks and luxury cars cost more.
Parts brand and whether the strut comes as a full assembly.
Whether an alignment is added, which is often recommended.
Shop type and local labor rates.
tips: Replace shocks or struts in pairs on the same axle so the car handles evenly.
Ask whether a full strut assembly or just the shock insert is quoted.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask if the alignment is included in the price.
faq: How much does it cost to replace shocks and struts?
Most US jobs cost about $500 to $2,500 depending on the car and the number of wheels. All four corners can cost more.
How much does one strut cost to replace?
One estimate puts front struts at about $300 to $700 each and rear struts at about $220 to $580 each, parts and labor included.
Do I need an alignment after replacing struts?
Often yes. Many shops recommend a four-wheel alignment after strut work because it can change the alignment angles.
Can I replace just one shock absorber?
It is better to replace both on the same axle. A mismatched pair can make the car handle unevenly.

topics.title: Water Pump Replacement Cost 2026: Fair Price Guide
topics.description: Water pump replacement in the US usually costs about $250 to $1,400. See why prices vary so much and how to avoid overpaying.
topics.answer: Water pump replacement in the United States usually costs about $250 to $1,400, parts and labor included. A pump that is easy to reach costs less, and a pump buried under other parts costs more. Electric pumps cost more than belt-driven ones.
factors: Labor: on some engines the radiator, hoses and pulleys must come off first.
Pump type: belt-driven pumps are cheaper than electric ones.
Car make and engine.
Whether the timing belt is replaced at the same time.
Coolant, thermostat and hoses that are often replaced with it.
Shop type and local labor rates.
tips: If the pump is driven by the timing belt, ask to replace both together to save labor.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask about the pump brand, since cheap pumps may wear out faster.
Ask whether a coolant flush is included or extra.
faq: How much does a water pump replacement cost?
In the US most jobs cost about $250 to $1,400 depending on the car. Labor is often the biggest part of the bill.
What are the signs of a failing water pump?
Common signs are a coolant leak, an engine that runs hot, or a whining noise from the front of the engine. Check the temperature gauge and stop driving if it climbs.
Should I replace the water pump with the timing belt?
If the water pump is driven by the timing belt, yes. The same labor covers both, so doing them together usually costs less than two separate jobs.
How long does a water pump last?
Many pumps last many years, but cheaper replacement pumps may wear out sooner, in some cases after about 30,000 miles.

topics.title: Car Dent Repair Cost 2026: Fair Price Guide for the US
topics.description: Fixing a car dent in the US costs about $75 to $600, depending on the size. See paintless repair prices and how to avoid overpaying.
topics.answer: Fixing a single car dent in the United States usually costs about $75 to $600. Small door dings repaired with paintless dent repair run about $75 to $300, while larger or more complex dents cost about $250 to $600. Dents that need body filler and paint, or hail damage across a whole car, cost much more.
factors: Dent size, depth and sharpness.
Whether the paint is cracked, which rules out paintless repair.
Panel material: aluminum costs more than steel.
Dents near a panel edge or crease are harder.
Number of dents on the same panel.
Local labor rates and shop type.
tips: Ask a paintless dent repair specialist first if the paint is not cracked.
Get a written quote that names the method, paintless or filler and paint.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask about a discount when fixing several dents in one visit.
Check your insurance deductible before using a claim for a small dent.
faq: How much does it cost to fix a dent in a car?
A single dent usually costs about $75 to $600 in the US. Small dings are at the low end, and bigger dents need more time and skill.
Is paintless dent repair cheaper?
Usually yes, if the paint is intact and the dent is in a reachable spot. It avoids body filler and repainting.
How much does hail damage repair cost?
Hail repair on a whole vehicle can run about $1,000 to $5,000 or more, depending on how many dents there are.
Can every dent be fixed without paint?
No. Cracked paint, very sharp creases and some edges need traditional bodywork and paint.

topics.title: Car Scratch Repair Cost 2026: What Is a Fair Price?
topics.description: Car scratch repair in the US costs about $50 to $1,500, depending on depth. See what a fair price is and how to avoid overpaying.
topics.answer: Car scratch repair in the United States costs about $50 to $1,500 depending on how deep the scratch is. A light surface scratch that can be buffed out may cost $50 to $150, while a deep scratch that needs repainting costs several hundred dollars or more. Panel size, paint type and shop all change the price.
factors: Depth: clear coat only, through the paint, or down to metal.
Size of the scratch and number of panels.
Paint type: pearl, metallic and tri-coat colors cost more.
Whether the panel must be repainted and blended.
Shop type: detailer, mobile repair or body shop.
Local labor rates.
tips: Run a fingernail across the scratch. If it does not catch, polishing may be enough.
Ask a detailer or mobile repair service before a full body shop.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask whether only the scratch is fixed or the whole panel is repainted.
faq: How much does it cost to fix a scratch on a car?
Prices run from about $50 for a light scratch to $1,500 for a large or deep one, according to one US guide. The depth of the scratch is the main factor.
Can a scratch be buffed out?
If the scratch is only in the clear coat, often yes. A scratch that goes through to the paint or metal needs repainting.
Is it worth fixing a small scratch?
Fixing a scratch early stops rust on bare metal, so it is usually worth it if the metal is exposed.
Does insurance cover scratches?
It depends on your policy and deductible. For small scratches the repair is often cheaper than the deductible.

topics.title: Bumper Repair Cost 2026: Repair vs Replace Prices
topics.description: Bumper repair in the US costs about $150 to $2,500, depending on damage and sensors. See repair and replace prices and how to save.
topics.answer: Bumper repair in the United States usually costs about $150 to $600 for the cover, with refinishing often $250 to $600 more. A painted bumper replacement runs about $800 to $2,500 for mainstream cars. Sensor and driver-assistance recalibration can add $300 to $800, and luxury or EV models can cost more.
rows: Repair a scuffed or cracked cover
Sensor or ADAS calibration, if needed
factors: Repair or replace, which depends on how badly the cover is cracked.
Paint color and blending into nearby panels.
Parking sensors, cameras and radar behind the bumper.
Car type: luxury, truck and EV models cost more.
Parts: OEM, aftermarket or used covers.
Shop type and labor rates.
tips: Ask if the bumper can be repaired instead of replaced.
Ask which sensors need recalibration and what it adds to the quote.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Compare OEM, aftermarket and used cover prices.
faq: How much does it cost to repair a bumper?
Most repairs cost about $150 to $600, and refinishing adds more. A full painted replacement costs about $800 to $2,500.
Is it cheaper to repair or replace a bumper?
Repair is cheaper for scuffs and light cracks. Replacement makes sense when the cover is badly cracked or the mounts are broken.
Do parking sensors raise bumper repair costs?
Yes. Sensors, cameras and radar may need repair or recalibration, which can add $300 to $800 or more.
How long does bumper repair take?
Simple repairs can often be done in a day. Replacement with paint often takes a few days.

topics.title: Windshield Replacement Cost 2026: Fair Price Guide
topics.description: Windshield replacement in the US costs about $250 to $1,500. See what drives the price, including camera calibration, and how to save.
topics.answer: Windshield replacement in the United States typically costs about $250 to $1,500 or more. A basic windshield is at the low end, while a car with cameras and driver-assistance sensors costs more because it needs calibration, often $250 to $600 extra. Check with your insurer, since some policies cover glass.
factors: Whether the car has cameras and driver-assistance sensors that need calibration.
Glass type: rain sensor, heated or acoustic glass costs more.
Car make, model and year.
OEM or aftermarket glass.
Mobile service or in-shop replacement.
Insurance coverage and deductible.
tips: Ask if a chip can be repaired first, which costs less than replacement.
Ask whether calibration is included in the quote.
Check your insurance, since some policies include glass cover.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask about OEM versus aftermarket glass.
faq: How much does it cost to replace a windshield?
In the US most windshields cost about $250 to $1,500 to replace. The price rises when the car has cameras and sensors that need calibration.
How much does ADAS calibration cost after a windshield replacement?
One source lists calibration at about $250 to $600 or more. AAA reported an average of $360 for the driver-assistance parts and calibration.
Is windshield replacement covered by insurance?
Some policies cover glass, and some do not cover the calibration separately. Check your policy before booking.
Can I repair a chip instead?
Small chips can often be repaired for about $130 to $150, which is far cheaper than replacing the whole windshield.

topics.title: Headlight Replacement Cost 2026: Bulb or Assembly
topics.description: Headlight replacement in the US costs $30 to $1,500, from a simple bulb to a full LED assembly. See fair prices and how to save.
topics.answer: Headlight replacement in the United States costs about $30 to $1,500 depending on the type. A bulb swap by a shop can cost $30 to $300, a halogen assembly about $200 to $500, and a modern LED assembly about $750 to $1,500. Some luxury and matrix systems cost far more.
factors: Bulb or full sealed assembly.
Halogen, HID or LED lighting.
Car make: luxury and matrix headlights cost far more.
Whether the bumper has to come off for access.
OEM, aftermarket or used assembly.
Whether the headlights need aiming afterward.
tips: Check if only the bulb is bad before buying an assembly.
Ask if a used or aftermarket assembly is approved for your car.
Ask for an itemized quote that lists parts and labor separately.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask whether headlight aiming is included.
faq: How much does it cost to replace a headlight?
A bulb swap by a shop costs about $30 to $300. A full assembly costs about $200 to $500 for halogen and about $750 to $1,500 for LED.
Why are modern headlights so expensive?
Many cars use sealed LED units that cannot be opened, so the whole assembly must be replaced. Some luxury systems can cost thousands.
Can I replace a headlight bulb myself?
On many cars yes, and it saves labor. On some cars the bumper or other parts must come off, so a shop may be the better choice.
Do headlights need to be aimed after replacement?
Often yes, especially after replacing a full assembly, so the beam points the right way.

topics.title: Toyota Camry Water Pump Replacement Cost 2026 Guide
topics.description: Toyota Camry water pump replacement in the US usually costs about $500 to $1,400. See the price range and how to avoid overpaying.
topics.h1: Toyota Camry water pump replacement cost
topics.answer: Replacing the water pump on a Toyota Camry in the United States usually costs about $500 to $1,400, parts and labor included, based on estimates for several model years. Older Camrys with an easy-to-reach pump can come in lower, and the price depends on the year, engine and your area.
factors: Model year and engine, such as four-cylinder or V6.
Pump design: belt-driven or electric.
Local labor rates and shop type.
Whether coolant, thermostat or belts are replaced with the pump.
Dealer or independent shop.
Parts brand.
tips: Ask for an itemized quote and compare an independent shop with the Toyota dealer.
Get a second quote from another shop before you agree.
Ask if the thermostat and belts are worth replacing at the same time.
Ask which pump brand is used and the warranty length.
Have the leak or overheating confirmed before approving the job.
faq: How much does a Toyota Camry water pump replacement cost?
Estimates run about $500 to $1,400 in the US, parts and labor included. Your exact quote depends on year, engine and area.
What are signs of a bad Camry water pump?
Look for a coolant leak near the front of the engine, a rising temperature gauge or a whining noise. Stop driving if the engine overheats.
Does the Camry water pump need replacing often?
Not usually, but a pump can leak or wear out with age, and cheaper replacement pumps may wear out sooner.
Should I replace other parts with the pump?
Many shops suggest replacing coolant and checking the thermostat and belts at the same time, since the labor overlaps.

Do I need new rotors with new pads?
